{
  "private": true,
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.28.1",
  "engines": {
    "node": "24.x"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev --turbopack",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "check": "pnpm typecheck && pnpm test",
    "check:release1": "node scripts/validate-auth-docs.mjs && node scripts/validate-release-checklist.mjs && pnpm validate:stripe-acceptance-inventory && node scripts/validate-toolchain-policy.mjs && node scripts/check-whitespace.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ci && pnpm test:integration-db && pnpm test:build-boundary && pnpm build",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "node --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types --test tests/*.test.ts",
    "test:ci": "node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter=dot tests/*.test.ts",
    "test:build-boundary": "node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --conditions=react-server --experimental-strip-types --test --test-reporter=dot tests/build-runtime-boundary.build.ts",
    "test:integration-db": "node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --experimental-strip-types scripts/run-integration-db.ts",
    "test:security-e2e": "playwright test -c playwright.security.config.ts",
    "test:security": "pnpm test:integration-db && pnpm test:security-e2e",
    "test:stripe-e2e": "playwright test -c playwright.stripe.config.ts",
    "db:setup": "npx tsx lib/db/setup.ts",
    "db:seed": "node --conditions=react-server --import tsx lib/db/seed.ts",
    "db:generate": "node --conditions=react-server node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs generate",
    "db:migrate": "node --conditions=react-server node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs migrate",
    "db:studio": "node --conditions=react-server node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs studio",

    "validate:auth-test-catalog": "node scripts/validate-auth-test-matrix.mjs && node scripts/generate-auth-test-docs.mjs --check",
    "generate:auth-test-docs": "node scripts/generate-auth-test-docs.mjs",
    "write:auth-ci-results": "node scripts/write-auth-ci-results.mjs",
    "merge:auth-test-results": "node scripts/merge-auth-test-results.mjs"
